get.description: Get all relevant shifts. Please see different response types below.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The max number of items to return

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor after which the next page should be fetched. Comes from the previous page's response

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: A datetime string to find shifts that start on or after this time.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: A datetime string to find shifts that start before this time.

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: An array of user IDs to filter shifts by employee.

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: An array of location IDs to filter shifts by location.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: An array of role IDs to filter shifts by role.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: An array of shift IDs to retrieve specific shifts.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: Filters for assigned or open shifts. If not provided, all shifts are returned, including open

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: Filters for either published or unpublished shifts. If not provided, all shifts are returned.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: If true, returns only deleted shifts. If false, returns non-deleted shifts.

parameters.name: acknowledged
parameters.description: Filters shifts based on whether the assigned employee has acknowledged them. If not provided, all shifts are returned

parameters.name: createdBy
parameters.description: Filters shifts by the user that created them.

parameters.name: createdAtStart
parameters.description: Filters shifts created on or after this datetime.

parameters.name: createdAtEnd
parameters.description: Filters shifts created on or before this datetime.

parameters.name: hasNotes
parameters.description: Filters shifts based on whether they contain notes.

403.description: The user is not allowed to access this resource

get.description: Check whether a user has clashing shifts on the provided dates for a given time window. Open shifts always return no clash.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: The start time of the shift in HH:mm format

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The end time of the shift in HH:mm format

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user ID to check clashes for. Use 0 for open shifts.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: The location ID of the shift being checked

parameters.name: dates
parameters.description: Dates to check for clashes in yyyy-MM-dd format

403.description: The user is not allowed to access this resource
